title: Learning maps
subtitle: Organize knowledge and keep notes you can revise.
deleteHint: Remove this content and {{count}} descendant nodes, including their notes, from the learning map.
name: Name

chart.description: {{title}} knowledge map. Open notes by clicking points, or collapse groups. The outline supports keyboard navigation.
chart.label: {{title}} interactive knowledge map
chart.empty: No knowledge points yet. Create one or ask the study assistant to propose a structure with initial notes.

chartHint: Click points for notes · Click groups to collapse · Drag to pan, scroll to zoom
outlineHint: Open notes from knowledge points; expand, collapse or edit groups.

empty.title: No learning topics yet
empty.hint: Create a topic or tell the study assistant what you want to learn. AI changes require your approval.

saveFailed: Save failed. Your edits remain here.
savePending: Changes have not been applied. Check the pending proposal.
conflict: This note changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Load the latest content, or merge the fields you edited onto the latest revision and review before saving.
discardHint: Discard this draft and load the latest saved content.
uncertain: The last save is unconfirmed. Retry the same save before continuing to edit.
storageFailed: Draft storage failed. Save before leaving this page.
imagesUnsupported: Image uploads are not supported for knowledge notes yet. Paste text or image links instead.
tooLong: The note exceeds 20,000 characters. Shorten it before saving.

workflow.overviewFailed: Could not load your learning progress.
workflow.unsupported: This workspace's server does not yet support practice, review, or learning history. Update the server to use these features. Maps and notes remain available to view and edit; existing answers and local drafts are retained.
workflow.failed: The operation did not complete. Please retry.
workflow.emptyNote: This note is empty. Edit it or ask the study assistant to help.
workflow.nodeUnavailable: This knowledge point is no longer available. Returned to the topic.

prompts.explain: Explain the key concept in the referenced knowledge point. Address my question first, then use a small example to check understanding.
prompts.example: Give a concrete example for this knowledge point, including when it applies and when it does not.
prompts.summarize: Read this session’s actual learning and practice records. Summarize my understanding, open questions and next steps. Propose useful note changes for approval without overwriting the original.
prompts.hint: Give me a gradual hint based on this question and my answer. Do not reveal the answer yet.

setup.title: Prepare practice
setup.description: Generate questions for your learning scope. Adopting the set saves the questions and practice progress.
setup.generating: Preparing questions. You can return later.
setup.candidate: {{count}} questions. Answers and grading rules are hidden in this preview.
setup.sourceHint: Questions use your notes or model-generated examples. You can request a review if something is ambiguous.
setup.pending: The previous request is unconfirmed. Retrying uses the same request to avoid duplicate questions or sessions.
setup.loadFailed: Could not load generation progress. The original job is preserved.

saveState.local: Saved on this device; server save not yet confirmed
saveState.pending: Submission unconfirmed; the original answer and request are preserved
saveState.conflict: The answer changed elsewhere. Resolve the conflict to continue
saveState.storageFailed: Device storage failed; answer remains in this page

practice.paused: This session is paused. Continue to answer questions.
practice.offline: Using this device’s cache. You can answer downloaded questions; submissions and grading require a connection.
practice.cacheFailed: Device storage failed. Keep this page open and copy your answer. Submissions without a recoverable request will not be sent.
practice.archived: This question or its learning content is unavailable. Historical questions, original answers and grades remain readable; further answers are disabled.
practice.operationPending: The previous operation is unconfirmed. Retry the original request.
practice.noQuestions: No questions are available in this session.
practice.finishHint: Finishing preserves submitted answers and grading jobs, and freezes this session. Unsubmitted drafts cannot be submitted afterwards. Unanswered and skipped questions are not counted as incorrect.
practice.conflict: Your device’s answer is preserved. Use the server answer or keep yours and save again. If another device has submitted, you can begin a new attempt.
practice.keepMine: Keep my answer and save again
practice.assistanceUncertain: Assistance outcome uncertain; not counted as confirmed independent work
practice.independent: No hint or solution recorded for this attempt
practice.modelGrade: AI grading against the rubric; review is available
practice.resultHint: Total and answered counts retain the session history. Retired items are listed separately and excluded from correct, incorrect and pending counts. Skipped or unanswered items are not errors; one correct answer does not mark a point as mastered.
practice.startHint: Each submission keeps your answer and grading history. Pause at any time and continue from the same question.
practice.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy your answer.
practice.archiveQuestionHint: Stop using this question in new practice and prevent further answers in existing sessions. Keep its original text, answers and grading history. Exclude its scores from results and review evidence, preserving manual scheduling.

reviews.title: Review queue
reviews.explanation: Review schedules and mastery states are separate. Due dates do not lower mastery, and correct answers do not automatically mark mastery.
reviews.empty: No matching reviews. Add one from a knowledge point.
reviews.policyHint: Rules v1: incorrect or partial answers suggest 1 day; consecutive independent correct answers suggest 2, 4, 8, 16, then 30 days. Other correct answers suggest 1 day. This is an adjustable app rule, not a proven optimal interval. Manual dates and pauses are preserved. Switch to manual, then back to spaced rules to resume automatic scheduling. No notifications are enabled.

records.title: Learning history
records.noPractice: No submitted practice yet. Completed attempts will appear here.
records.checkpointHint: This checkpoint appears in your history and continue-learning section. It does not change notes or mastery.

path.title: Suggested next steps
path.reason: Use saved states across this topic: consolidate first, then continue learning. Outline order breaks ties. These are not inferred prerequisites.
path.empty: There are no other points to review, continue or start. Keep reading or choose your own next step.

reasons.review: Reason: you marked this point for review.
reasons.learning: Reason: this point is still in progress.
reasons.todo: Reason: this point has not been started.

selectionReasons.recent_incorrect: Revisit a previous incorrect or partial answer
selectionReasons.mixed_practice: Mixed practice within your selected scope
selectionReasons.recent_mistake_variant: A new scenario based on a previous mistake
